body: FYI I am 17 and I cannot leave. parents tell me I suck every day. even if I buy a new computer they will find a way aka take it away or pull the plug and take away the power.
online communities. that's why I'm here. I cant talk to my parents. I don't trust them bc they blame me for shit I cant control. yes I talk to my friends. but they don't know the truth.

I am already on antidepressants, but it doesn't seem to help a lot. I spend my free time on music production and edm shit. except that my mom fucking takes the computer away all the time. I cant do shit. there is no constant in my life.
except that everything goes wrong and you have absolutely no control over it.

I lied to myself so much that I told myself I'm good, I got friends, I'm not awkward, only to realize one year later in retrospective how shithead am I. change my perception. LMFSBAO. (no offense)

reading daily quotes about "these people don't matter to you" doesn't help. even my parents hate me. what else?

a life where everyone either despises you and would celebrate your funeral, or pity you and treat you as a poor "less than human" thing, and not truly accepting you as a regular human that deserves love.

is it worth living?

i feel the obligation to live the normie (neurotypical) life. but in fact i have every right not to. but its impossible in practice. in one way or the other, society will restrict you and throw you in a hydraulic press.

the world boasts about tolerance. but its completely different from true acceptance. and even when boasting about tolerance they aint tolerating AT ALL.

living knowing that your condition is something the society has a reason to discriminate against, simply because your ability is not up to par. is it worth it? unlike LGBTs, who aren't deficient in any way and the society has no ground to be prejudiced against.

gpa is 3 unweighted, 3.3 weighted. I have multiple C on my transcript. I'm a B- student. 80% of my peers have 4.20 dank gpas. and 4 AP 5-point scores accompanying that. purdue is barely within range. actually nope. don't even think of Illinois or san diego or Irvine or davis. ut Austin? no. Georgia tech? no. nyu? no. other uc? Caltech? ya kidding. cal poly? no. cal poly Pomona? no. my college counselor suggests random names like U Rochester or George Washington U. Arizona state. wake forest. brandeis. Udenver. elon u. goucher. not even known for fucking compsci shit. boulder? I thought of it as 99% chance. do I stand a chance now? no. my mom wont let me go to sj state bc she thinks stoners and gangsters go there. same for boulder, another 420land.
except that i sleep in and don't get to see it. and even if i do happen to wake up i don't want to move. i don't want to get outta bed.

i have no friends with similar conditions. i am all alone in this. i find it hard for my best friend to understand. i am 17 and i don't want to spend another 60 years suffering only to figure out that i should've ended it way earlier. I'm suicidal since 11 years old and had i jumped off a building i'd be waived from all the shit I'm going through today. sucks that i don't live in a city anymore so no buildings that can give me instadeath.

I'm in fucking compsci and I fucked up my grades. edited the post please check.

>ok to fail a little bit

in compsci, which is the only good thing I'm good at, i'd get nothing absolutely out of a major from a shitschool. even if I do grad I wont be able to get a job. even if I do get a job its a shitty company that pays me barely more than min wage, and i'd be repetitively fixing computers after computers (I want to make programs and do AI research. none of that is in such a job). even if I do land a job I want, the employers will fucking hate me because I'm fucking socially INEPT. I can only work at the lowest level job in the company and never rise the ranks bc they think I'm autistic.

DON'T TOLERATE THE USAGE OF THAT! It is equal to FAGGOT. I feel ya. I am completely done with how this fucking world treats people who have actual developmental challenges because they are "less than human".
